title: Warp field
description: A field of fine threads swaying slightly out of step.
alt: About two dozen thin, gently curved vertical threads, mostly pale linen with a few peach, rose, blue and yellow ones, sway slowly from side to side.
note: A negative animation-delay per thread starts every thread mid-sway, so the field is already moving on the first frame and never shows a synchronised start. Review found the lean pivoting around the page corner by default; the second version names the pivot, the top of the threads, which is what makes them look hung.
author: Maria Roszyk
